title: Critical tribes function
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s$ be the greatest size up to $2^{w+2}$ for which $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le \tfrac12$. The critical tribes function is the tribes Boolean function with block width $w$ and $s$ blocks, on $sw$ coordinates, taking values in $\{−1,1\}$.
